findings.description: Hinrich Burmeister and his wife had a son Hinrich, baptised 29 July 1687 at Schönberg, Mecklenburg — a second son of that name, after the one christened in 1683.
supporting_sources: Deutschland, ausgewählte evangelische Kirchenbücher 1500-1971 — baptism of Hinrich Burmeister, 29 Jul 1687, parents Hinrich Burmeister and Elsch Burmeister

findings.description: The 'Elsch Burmeister' named as the child's mother is Liesbeth Oldenburg, the subject's first wife (m. 1682, d. 1689), recorded under her married surname — not an additional spouse.
supporting_sources: Deutschland, ausgewählte evangelische Kirchenbücher 1500-1971 — baptism of 29 Jul 1687
